subject: Voluntary sunsetting plan, notice window, and escrow request
messages:
From: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@lumenhealth.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@lumenhealth.com
Date: 2026-08-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed changes: auto-renew, notice window, and escrow for sunsetting

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. Procurement has reviewed the MSA + Order Form and we have three items that need clarity before we can move to signature:

1) Auto-renew: Lumen is asking for an opt-out window of 60 days prior to renewal rather than the 30 days in your current Order Form. We need that buffer for budgeting/board approval cycles.

2) Termination for convenience (TFC): We prefer a shorter notice for pilot accounts (30 days) but understand full customers may need 60. Can we add a pilot carveout in the Order Form?

3) Voluntary sunsetting / escrow: Because we host models and prefixes, procurement wants an escrow-style mechanism for customer-accessible handoff artifacts (exported KV, data export instructions) and an agreed bridge fee to cover a 90-day extraction/support window. They asked for suggested language — attached is Lumen_Redlines_v1.docx with redlines in tracked changes.

Can you route to legal and confirm what Redwood can agree to and any counter language you propose? We’re targeting a signing window by end of August.

Thanks,
Maria Ortega
Senior Procurement Manager
LumenHealth
(Attachment: Lumen_Redlines_v1.docx - tracked changes)

From: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
To: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-12T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed changes: auto-renew, notice window, and escrow for sunsetting

Hi Maria — appreciate the clear ask and the redlines. Looping in Ben (sales lead) and Karthik/Laura from legal/procurement ops so we can respond in one pass.

High level: we’re willing to consider a longer opt-out for renewals on enterprise SKUs, but it interacts with billing cutoffs and our commitment calendar. Pilot carveouts are reasonable if scoped and timeboxed. For escrow/sunsetting we prefer a playbook approach (artifacts + runbook + support hours) vs. a traditional escrow agent. Bridge fee is fine as a line item; need to align on amounts and SOW.

Karthik/Laura — can you review Lumen_Redlines_v1 and propose marked counter language? If feasible please produce a concise counter with redlines and an example fee schedule. We should aim to keep changes scoped to Order Form amendments rather than reopening MSA core rights if possible.

Naomi
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: — none in this message)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-12T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: draft counter for Lumen — auto-renew, TFC pilot carveout, and sunsetting language

Team,

I reviewed Lumen_Redlines_v1 and prepared a short counter. Key points below, and I attached Redwood_Response_Redline.pdf with in-line edits:

1) Auto-renew / notice window: Offer two-tier notice: enterprise (60 days) and pilot/POC (30 days) — good compromise. Add explicit billing cutoff sentence: "Charges for the renewal term are invoiced on the first day of the renewal term; opt-out requests must be received prior to the billing cutoff (30 days before renewal invoice) to prevent charges." This preserves our operational calendar while honoring their 60-day request for contract notice.

2) Termination for convenience (TFC): For pilots, allow 30-day TFC with a de-escalating service credit schedule for early termination to protect our ramp costs. For full production accounts, keep 60-day TFC. Define "pilot" as Order Form line item with limited TCV (< $50k) and 3-month max.

3) Voluntary sunsetting / escrow: Propose a "Sunsetting Playbook" exhibit (Order Form Exhibit C) that lists export artifacts (KV cache dump, config, prompt sets), an operational runbook for handoff, and a fixed 90-day support window for a bridge fee. We decline to put live model binaries into a third-party escrow but will provide exports + scripted restore instructions. Suggest bridge fee tiers: $15k (up to $100k TCV), $30k (100-500k), custom above that.

Next steps: Ben — confirm commercial appetite on bridge fee tiers and pilot carveout definitions. Naomi — please keep customer informed and flag any counter-asks. Laura — if legal is comfortable with Exhibit C approach, we’ll send the redline to Lumen. I’ve attached the draft.

Karthik
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Redwood_Response_Redline.pdf)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@lumenhealth.com>, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-12T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed changes: auto-renew, notice window, and escrow for sunsetting

Hi Maria — thanks for sending the redlines. Attaching our suggested Order Form Exhibit C and a short commercial note (OrderForm_draft_v2.pdf). Summary of the commercial compromise:

• Renewal notice: 60 days for enterprise; 30 days for pilots (pilot flagged on order form).
• Pilot definition: TCV < $50k, duration <= 3 months, single environment, no SLA credits.
• Bridge fee tiers as Karthik proposed. We can discount the first-year bridge fee by 50% if Lumen signs a 12-month committed order.

We’re happy to walk through the draft this week. Naomi — can you set up a 30-minute call tomorrow for final alignment? Maria — if that works, we’ll follow with a DocuSign package after you confirm the exhibit language.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Sales
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: OrderForm_draft_v2.pdf)

From: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@lumenhealth.com>

Hi Ben / Naomi — appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear exhibit approach. The procurement committee reviewed Redwood_Response_Redline.pdf and OrderForm_draft_v2.pdf this morning. We have two small asks before we can confirm the signing call:

1) Please add a short example of what the exported KV artifact looks like (schema + max size) in Exhibit C so our infra team can validate restoration feasibility.
2) Can you add a one-paragraph escalation path if Redwood is unable to deliver the export within the 90-day support window (e.g., prorated refund or extension mechanics)?

If you can add those two bullets to Exhibit C we’ll confirm the 30-minute signing alignment tomorrow at 10:00 AM PT and then ask for DocuSign.
